newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil confirms Band B cell phone bids due April 7.
newsitem.headline: Brazil confirms Band B cell phone bids due April 7.

text.p: Brazil's Communications Ministry confirmed Thursday it would receive bids for 10 Band B cellular phone concessions on April 7 and denied a newspaper report that suggested the bid date might be extended.
In a statement the Ministry said that it "absolutely does not consider any delay in the (April 7) date", for the delivery of the competing bids.

Today's Folha de Sao Paulo quoted a senior communications ministry official as saying the government might allow some bidders to deliver their bids after the April 7 deadline if they provided good reasons to do so.
Brazil's Band B auctions have drawn the attention of the world's biggest cellular operators and represent the first opening of Brazil's promising cellular market to foreign capital.
